notice: Google Photos Takeout naming rules are public observations of exports (2019-2025), not a vendor specification. Every sidecar-to-media link is a hypothesis named by its rule id; ambiguous matches choose nothing. Edit this file (new version) when a real export shows other rules.

rules.title_exact_v1: sidecar title equals the media file name (only when the sidecar name has no counter)
rules.base_without_extension_v1: sidecar <stem>.json (no media extension in the name) describes media <stem>.<any media ext>
rules.truncated_sidecar_prefix_v1: sidecar name at the observed length limit: its (cut) base is a prefix of the media name
rules.truncated_media_name_v1: media name at the observed length limit: its stem is a prefix of the sidecar title stem, same extension
rules.edited_variant_v1: media <stem><edited suffix>.<ext> is an edited copy of a described media file; listed, never counted as the described file
